reachableVia: extractLabelEvidenceDetailed returns DetailedExtractionResult.debug, which is untruncated. The acquisition calls that function directly; it does not use the evaluation harness, whose CaseReport projection is what applied the caps.

capsExplicitlyNotApplied.MAX_SAMPLE_WORDS_PER_REGION: the 25-word sampleWords cap in eval-harness.ts is a CaseReport projection and is bypassed by reading extractionDebug directly
capsExplicitlyNotApplied.MAX_TEXT_LEN: the 120-character truncate() applied to CaseReport strings is likewise bypassed

opaqueItemId.value: the opaque item identifier; the schema field is NOT named caseId

role.derivedFrom: passKind plus triggerReasons; primary vs recovery

cropPixelSha256.note: Computed by this acquisition over the preprocessed PNG buffer handed to the engine. It is an observation of an existing byte stream, not a change to preprocessing.

transformAndOrientation.source: PlannedOcrPass.transform (rotate, scale, originalWidth, originalHeight) and template.preprocessing

passOutputFingerprint.computedAs: sha256 of canonical JSON over the ordered word records

originalWordOrder.note: array index in the emitted order, preserved exactly

originalGeometry.note: present once a pass has mapped the token back to the original image frame; recorded as null where absent rather than omitted

baselineGeometry.why: OcrWord carries no baseline. Exposing it would require changing the production OCR adapter, which this sprint forbids.

blockParagraphLineIdentifiers.why: The production adapter maps tesseract.js output to OcrWord, which carries no block, paragraph or line identifier. Exposing them would require a production change.
blockParagraphLineIdentifiers.mitigation: Reconstructed-line membership is captured separately in reconstructed-line-contract.json, which is the grouping the Brand path actually uses.

truncationAssertions: observed maximum words per pass and per case are recorded
observed maximum lines per case are recorded
the emitted word count per pass must equal the length of the debug pass word array
historicalNote: Amendment 1 described this evidence as reachable through runCaseArtifacts. That route is prohibited from Amendment 2 onward.
completeRegionOcrResultPersistence: Every RegionOcrResult field is persisted exactly; see region-ocr-result-replay-contract.json. The per-pass field list here is explanatory and is not a licence to persist a subset.
